ईह्, i. 1, Ātm. (sometimes Par.)
 1. To aim at,

.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pres. [] अन्-ईहमान, Not desiring, Yājñ. 2, 116.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass., ईहित, Desired,

.
 --Comp.
 आयती-, adj. referring to future time,

.
 --With the prep. सम् सम्, To desire, Pañc. iii. d. 87; i. d. 105 (Par.).
 समीहित, n. Desire,
